# technitium_permissions_zones (Resource)

Manages who may view, modify and delete in the Zones section. The lists set here are the section's full lists: users and groups left out lose their rights, except the built-in admin groups, which the server always keeps; list those too, or take them from the data source of the same name. Destroying the resource leaves the permissions as they are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_permissions_zones" "this" {
  user_permissions = [
    { username = technitium_user.alice.username, can_view = true, can_modify = false, can_delete = false },
  ]

  group_permissions = [
    # The server always keeps the built-in admin groups, so list them as it has them.
    { name = "Administrators", can_view = true, can_modify = true, can_delete = true },
    { name = "DNS Administrators", can_view = true, can_modify = true, can_delete = true },
    { name = technitium_group.ops.name, can_view = true, can_modify = true, can_delete = false },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group_permissions` (Attributes Set) The rights of groups, including the built-in admin groups the server keeps. Leaving it out keeps the server's. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_permissions))
- `user_permissions` (Attributes Set) The rights of individual users. An empty set removes them; leaving it out keeps the server's. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_permissions))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--group_permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group_permissions`

Required:

- `can_delete` (Boolean) May delete in the section.
- `can_modify` (Boolean) May change the section.
- `can_view` (Boolean) May view the section.
- `name` (String) The group name.


<a id="nestedatt--user_permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user_permissions`

Required:

- `can_delete` (Boolean) May delete in the section.
- `can_modify` (Boolean) May change the section.
- `can_view` (Boolean) May view the section.
- `username` (String) The username.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import technitium_permissions_zones.this permissions_zones
```
